claims.claim_text: The remediated simulator has a declared and testable numerical process: exchange preserves total wealth and non-negativity, invalid state fails explicitly, random streams are seed- and stable-ID-keyed, controls execute the process named in the design, and required metrics have valid stationarity and precision diagnostics.

Under matched resource totals, histograms, accessible area, population, and initial wealth, clustered versus shuffled resource landscapes produce a numerically resolvable difference in preregistered steady-window spatial metrics.
The movement path and the production-decay source-sink path can be described without attributing a structurally impossible spatial feedback to production.
Any supported Cycle 4 landscape effect retains direction under separately designed system-size, density, grid-discretization, and holdout-landscape checks.
